purpose: Validate the afterfire peak-vs-engine-body red flag (firecracker check) retained for the Jovi audition. The red flag is a WHOLE-CLIP aggregate (peak vs body), not an event-aligned attack metric; the event-aligned window honestly reports NOT_MEASURABLE because afterfire has no single clean transient, so no fabricated timing is emitted.

whole_clip_metric.metric_kind: WHOLE_CLIP_AGGREGATE (peak envelope frame vs 60th-percentile body dB)

red_flag.note: event-body 120-400Hz injection lifts afterfire transient peaks far above the engine body; keep as RED FLAG for Jovi audition (firecracker check).

event_aligned_window.reason: no distinct event transient (peak-floor -2.94 dB < 1.0 dB)
